mapper.select: SELECT instance_id, instance_name, host_ip, redis_port, role, redis_version, run_status, last_heartbeat_time, master_host_ip, master_redis_port FROM redis_instance WHERE management_status = #{managementStatus} ORDER BY CASE role WHEN 'MASTER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, instance_name ASC
mapper.sql: cpu_per AS "cpuUsage", mem_server_per AS "serverMemUsage", mem_us AS "redisMemUsed", ops AS "qps", cmd_latency AS "avgLatency", io_iik AS "netInputBandwidth", io_iok AS "netOutputBandwidth"
mapper.select: SELECT , tm AS "collectTime", FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY tm DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT , tm AS "collectTime" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY tm DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT AVG(cpu_per) AS "cpuAvg", MAX(cpu_per) AS "cpuMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY cpu_per DESC LIMIT 1) AS "cpuMaxTim", AVG(mem_us) AS "redisMemAvg", MAX(mem_us) AS "redisMemMax", AVG(ops) AS "qpsAvg", MAX(ops) AS "qpsMax", AVG(cmd_latency) AS "latencyAvg", MAX(cmd_latency) AS "latencyMax" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT id, instance_id, instance_name, host_ip, redis_port, role, redis_version, run_status, master_host_ip, master_redis_port, last_heartbeat_time, management_status, created_time, updated_time FROM redis_instance WHERE management_status = #{managementStatus}
